localLocationsDescription: The local space managed by Mergeron and other local folders attached to this project. Remote connections are listed separately.
managedLocalDescription: The managed local space is the project’s permanent primary location. Working files are separate from internal data in the .mergeron directory, reserved for the application and hidden by default in the file listing.
systemFilesHidden: Mergeron internal data is hidden in this listing.
systemFilesVisible: Technical view of Mergeron internal data.
systemFilesTechnicalHelp: The .mergeron directory is reserved for the application. This view changes neither your permissions nor existing protections. Project files, including .git and .env, are not hidden by this option.
gitCloneFailed: Could not create the copy. Check repository access and the requested branch.
gitUnbornDiffHelp: Before the first commit, only staged changes are displayed. Unstaged changes are not included.
detachResourceDescription: This only removes the resource connection from the project. The remote repository and all remote and local files will NOT be deleted. Associated working copies will be marked as revoked and will no longer be available to agents; their files will be kept.
gitResourceMissing: This resource is no longer available.
gitDisabledHelp: This connection is disabled. Enable it in the project’s Locations and connections tab.
gitLocalSnapshot: Local snapshot; refresh does not fetch from the remote.
gitNoCopy: The remote is connected. Prepare a working copy to browse and work locally.
gitCopyHelp: Creates an isolated clone. The current agent's workspace and files remain unchanged.
gitInspectionError: Unable to inspect this copy. Refresh or check its availability.
gitBrowseError: Unable to open the files in this copy.
gitBrowseHelp: Browsing does not change the agent’s active working directory.
gitNoSnapshot: Prepare a copy and refresh to inspect Git.
gitBranchesHelp: Branches known in this clone. To work on another remote branch, prepare an isolated copy instead of switching under an agent.
gitLimited: Results are limited. Check the full list on your Git provider.
gitChangesHelp: Select a file to compare it. Git actions require explicit confirmation; no automatic deletion.
gitDiffHelp: Changes compared with the current commit (including staged and unstaged changes).
gitDiffError: Unable to load the comparison. Refresh the working copy.
gitUntracked: New file, not yet tracked. Open it to inspect its content.
gitNoTextDiff: No text comparison available (binary file, conflict or metadata-only change).
gitGithubError: GitHub unavailable or access denied. Check this resource's token and permissions.
gitProviderUnsupported: PRs and checks are currently available for github.com. Files and branches work with other Git hosts.
gitMergeUnknown: Conflict detection in progress or unavailable.
gitNoChecks: No checks reported. This does not mean a merge is approved.
gitMergeHelp: Checks alone do not authorize a merge. GitHub reviews and branch protections still apply. The state is rechecked before merging.
gitActionBusy: Wait until all active agents and Git operations on this server have finished.
gitActionAgentStateUnknown: Unable to verify agent inactivity. Restore the agent service connection before retrying.
gitActionStale: Git changed since your review. Close this window, refresh and review again.
gitActionMergeBlocked: Merge blocked: check status, reviews, conflicts and branch protections on GitHub.
gitActionInProgress: Finish the current merge, rebase or conflict resolution first.
gitActionBranchRequired: Select a named local branch first.
gitActionHttpsRequired: Push from this panel currently requires an HTTPS Git resource without credentials in its URL.
gitActionTokenRequired: Configure a GitHub token with merge permissions for this resource.
gitActionIdentityRequired: Enter a valid commit author name and email.
gitActionOutcomeUnknown: The connection ended before confirmation. Refresh the PR on GitHub before retrying; it may already be merged.
gitActionFailed: Operation failed or its outcome is unknown. Refresh Git and verify before retrying.
gitActionStagedHelp: Commit includes staged changes only. Prepare them with Git or your agent; unstaged edits are preserved.
gitActionPushHelp: Publish only the reviewed commit to the same branch on the configured remote. No force push, deletion or automatic merge. Uncommitted edits are not published.
gitActionCommitHelp: Review the staged changes below. Only this frozen index will be committed; unstaged files are left untouched. Hooks and signing are not executed by this panel.
gitActionMergeHelp: Creates a merge commit on the PR target branch. Checks and revisions are rechecked on the server. GitHub branch protections apply. The local copy is not updated and no branch is deleted.
